create_auginput_with_tensor: create an AugInput object with a torch tensor image and optional bounding boxes
apply_transform_to_auginput: apply a Transform in-place to an AugInput to transform its image, boxes, and segmentation
apply_augmentations_to_auginput: apply a list of Augmentations or Transforms to an AugInput and return the AugmentationList
convert_tensor_to_array: convert a CHW torch tensor image to an HWC numpy array using Tensor2Array
convert_array_to_tensor: convert an HWC numpy array image to a CHW torch tensor using Array2Tensor
